test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). C is at third position from right end of the row. A is fourth to the left of E. D is to the right of B. What is the position of D from the left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Five persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing north.

C is at third position from right end.

A is fourth to the left of E.

D is to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7efd952c7382f49a69e98f9b839d549625324f2db243849bb6ac6833ea8e6d25.png] 

Position of D from left end = 4th

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
